## Story DD Coverage
(None — infrastructure task; DD ownership via task-3 plan which calls this function.)

Add importable function enumerate_stale_anomalies(tickets_dir, now=None) -> list[dict] to plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-bridge-fsck.py. Returns same stale-entry shape ({ticket_id, jira_key, last_sync_ts}) currently produced by audit_bridge_mappings()['stale']. Refactor audit_bridge_mappings to delegate stale enumeration to the new function internally. Existing CLI output and exit codes unchanged (pure additive API change).

## TDD Test Spec
Given a temp ticket dir with one stale SYNC mapping; When enumerate_stale_anomalies(tickets_dir) is called; Then it returns a list matching audit_bridge_mappings()['stale'] on same input. Given the existing CLI run; Then stdout report and exit code are byte-identical to pre-refactor baseline.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Add enumerate_stale_anomalies() importable function to ticket-bridge-fsck.py
